Director Priyadarshan Exits Hera Pheri 3 Amidst Uncertainty

Filmmaker Priyadarshan has confirmed his departure from the upcoming film Hera Pheri 3, citing legal disputes and personal differences. His exit casts significant doubt on the film's future, with Priyadarshan expressing uncertainty about whether it will ever be released. The news has reportedly disappointed fans of the popular franchise.
